Order Order

No. 12.09.2024  02.
 1.
The petitioner is an accused in connection with Basudebpur P.S. Case No.94 of 2024 corresponding to Special POCSO Case No.11 of 2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/34 of the IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhadrak.
The petitioner had approached the learned Additional District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhadrak in Special POCSO Case No.11 of 2024 praying for grant of bail.
The learned Court below vide its order dated 20.03.2024 rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
3.

The prosecution case as per the F.I.R. is that, on 09.02.2024 at about 8.25 P.M., the complainant reported at Basudebpur P.S. that on 08.02.2024, her daughter went to the Batada Bazar for repairing her cycle, but she did not return to her home till 4 P.M.
The complainant searched for her daughter everywhere, but she could not trace her out.

Hence, the F.I.R.

4. The statement of the victim girl, who is stated to be 17 years age at the time of the incident, has been recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
She has stated that she had developed relationship with the petitioner through the instagram and she had been to Cuttack with him in the motor cycle.
Thereafter, they went to Bhadrak.
At Bhadrak, both of them stayed for three days in a common friend's house.
At that point of time, they had physical relationship.
Subsequent thereto, both of them came to Cuttack and got married in a Mosque.
5. The petitioner has been in custody since 17.02.2024.
He is stated to be 21 years old.

6. Regard being had to the period of custody of the petitioner since 17.02.2024, nature of accusation and the fact that the petitioner and the victim girl have already married as per the statement of the victim girl, I am inclined to admit the petitioner on bail.

7. Hence, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it would deem just and proper, subject to the following additional conditions:
(1) The petitioner shall appear before the Court, without fail, on every date of hearing; and (2) He shall not influence any of the witnesses related to this case in any manner whatsoever.

In the event the petitioner is found wanting for violation of any of the bail conditions imposed by this Court or the trial Court even on a single occasion, the prosecution is at liberty to move appropriate application before the Court below for cancellation of the concession of bail granted by this Court.
If such application is filed, the trial Court should decide the application on its own merit.
8. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Subhasis Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
